lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular clusters are arranged in a multi-layered grid posterior to the gill slits. Primary alignment consists of approximately four horizontal rows. Inter-blob distance remains relatively constant in the mid-flank, with spots decreasing in size and spacing density towards the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are clearly visible, aligned perpendicularly to the longitudinal axis. These bands intersect with the lateral spots, creating a grid where spots act as focal points within the vertical luminance strips.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank. They are defined by a linear highlight on the superior edge and a dark shadow gradient on the inferior edge. The primary ridge originates above the pectoral fin and extends towards the second dorsal fin.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 8-10 discrete high-luminance blobs. These are concentrated primarily in the posterior half of the fin area with a sparse distribution near the leading edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Extreme transition in spot morphology from the head to the flank; the cephalic region exhibits a high-density cluster of micro-spots compared to the macro-spots on the lateral body.
